traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: The mind meets disruption and originality. Fast, unconventional, leap-of-insight thinking that resists linear order. The trine makes this a natural strength: Brilliant, inventive insight and quick grasp of new systems and technology. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Thinking and disruption flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what thinking and disruption have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Strong for innovation, problem-solving, and tech; weak for routine detail and steady communication.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and instability for its own sake go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.

readerCopy.body: Spotting the single detail everyone else glossed over fixes a problem that has been costing time and money. A minor system update or a quick correction on paper resolves the issue right at the root. Mercury catches the error, while Uranus replaces the outdated process that allowed it to continue. Under the trine, a small correction travels through the system and clears a much larger blockage. The fix may look minor on paper even as the entire workflow becomes faster once it is made.
